messages:
kim: ok this is peak chaos, Taco (ferret) somehow turned the laundry basket into a sleeping taco
filestash-bot: uploaded image: taco_laundry_taco.jpg (1200x800)
sam: omg the tilt on his head. is that a tiny sock hat? :rofl:
ryan: tiny sock hat, big energy. caption contest?
ryan: 1) "Taco Tuesday but make it cozy"
ryan: 2) "When you fake being a burrito to avoid chores"
tara: 3) "Laundry: 1, Humans: 0" :laughing:
leo: vote 3 then 1. also yes to merch.
kim: quick poll: should i bring him to the office holiday treat day? crate-free demonstration. :eyes:
sam: yes but bring extra socks.
leo: absolutely yes. he'll boost Q4 morale by 37% (unverified). :chart_with_upwards_trend:
filestash-bot: reaction :heart: added by sam
kim: ok majority yes. i'll prepare a tiny sweater in red.
ryan: can we add a tiny bandana with the Redwood logo? :redwood: (jk, but also maybe)
tara: tagging @people-ops because logistics but also dog-wrangling experience req'd :wave:
kim: noted. for now i'll leave Taco loafing in his basket and accept all virtual cheer and treats :paw_prints:
